name: DAC80501
description: Driver for the TI DACx0501 family (DAC80501/DAC70501/DAC60501) over either SPI or I2C. The transport is injected, so two instances can share a bus on separate chip selects. Register map and output arithmetic are Arduino-free and host tested. Public headers live one level up in src/ and are reached through the project-wide -Isrc flag. Board-specific calibration deliberately lives in the consuming firmware, not here.
keywords: dac, dac80501, dacx0501, spi, i2c, analog-output
